days.title: Glacial Heights and Mountain Summits
days.start: Suggested: 9 AM start, after checking official access hours

stops.name: Hochfeiler
stops.detail: Surrounded by numerous peaks over 3,000 metres – with the Hochfeiler as the highest summit – the valley is considered the birthplace of Alpine mountaineering.

stops.name: Hintertux Glacier
stops.detail: In winter, the Zillertal in Tirol transforms into a true skier’s paradise: over 540 km of slopes, modern cable cars and the Hintertux Glacier guarantee snow fun at altitudes of up to 3,250 metres.

days.title: Action Slopes and Alpine Transit
days.start: Suggested: 9 AM start, after checking official access hours

stops.name: Actionberg Penken
stops.detail: Those seeking a sporting challenge cannot miss Actionberg Penken.

stops.name: Harakiri run
stops.detail: Here, Austria's steepest ski slope awaits the bravest: the legendary Harakiri run with up to 78% gradient.

stops.name: Zillertal Railway
stops.detail: The historic Zillertal Railway connects Mayrhofen with Jenbach, offering a nostalgic ride through the valley.

days.title: Family Adventures and Forest Playgrounds
days.start: Suggested: 9 AM start, after checking official access hours

stops.name: Spieljoch
stops.detail: The small ski area at Spieljoch is particularly family-friendly, featuring a fun park, fun slope, toboggan run, and wide pistes.

stops.name: Fichtenschloss
stops.detail: Located in Zell am Ziller, Fichtenschloss is an adventure playground made of spruce wood, featuring several towers and offering a great view of the surrounding area.
